scope: Original and modern LING285 studios, both modules, all numbered collections and shared readers.

structure: Teaching notes is the default collection mode.
The collection title, version selector and view tabs stay above the inline reader.
Visual + transcript opens the inline reader.
Expand visual + transcript opens a full-screen reader.
Closing expanded view returns to the same page in inline mode.

timer: The same running timer moves between the course header and expanded toolbar; its duration dropdown is excluded from generic source-selector fitting. All timer controls occupy one row without duplicate duration captions.

checks: Complete collection title, metadata, source links, version selector and tabs preserved in inline mode.
Explicit mode transitions, page choices, reload into notes, expanded Close and Escape return paths.
Independent transcript/visual scrolling with top/bottom wheel containment.
Single timer identity, one-row timer geometry, running countdown maintained through expansion and return.
Transcript reveal, notes/read marks, seven transcript choices, quiz entry and progress backups.
Current 100-question test and all eight full 50-question lecture quizzes.
